title: 업무 메신저 쓰기: 자료 받는 대로 올릴게요
objective: You can use -는 대로 to promise quick action in a work chat.
summary: A team leader and a staff member plan tomorrow's meeting materials in a work chat.
setting: A company team chat room in the afternoon. Team leader Kim is out of the office, and staff member Lee Sujin is preparing materials for tomorrow's meeting.

task.title: Write work chat messages
task.line: Use the dialogue and the word list to complete each message, choose the natural reply, or write a short message in Korean.

words.meaning: as soon as (verb + 는 대로; used to promise quick action)
words.exampleMeaning: I'll let you know as soon as the results are out.
I sent the meeting materials by email.

words.meaning: to share (information or files with the team)
words.exampleMeaning: If the schedule changes, please share it with the team members.

words.meaning: to post, to upload (in a chat room)
words.exampleMeaning: I posted the report in the team chat room.

words.meaning: working outside the office (visiting clients, etc.)
words.example: 오늘 오후에는 외근이 있어서 자리에 없어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I have an outside appointment this afternoon, so I won't be at my desk.

words.meaning: a reply (to a message or email)
words.exampleMeaning: Please reply as soon as you get the email.

words.meaning: please check it (polite, used when you send something)

dialogue.korean: 수진 씨, 내일 회의 자료는 어떻게 되고 있어요?
dialogue.meaning: Sujin, how are the materials for tomorrow's meeting coming along?

dialogue.korean: 거의 다 했습니다. 영업팀에서 매출 숫자만 받으면 돼요.
dialogue.meaning: They're almost done. I just need the sales figures from the sales team.

dialogue.korean: 그럼 영업팀 자료가 오는 대로 이 방에 공유해 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: Then please share them in this chat room as soon as the sales team's data comes in.

dialogue.korean: 네, 알겠습니다. 정리되는 대로 바로 올리겠습니다.
dialogue.meaning: Okay. I'll post the materials as soon as they're organized.

dialogue.korean: 고마워요. 제가 지금 외근 중이라서 답장이 좀 늦을 수 있어요.
dialogue.meaning: Thanks. I'm out of the office right now, so my replies may be a bit slow.

dialogue.korean: 네, 자료 올리면 확인 부탁드립니다. 수정할 부분이 있으면 말씀해 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: Okay. Please check the materials when I post them. Let me know if anything needs to be changed.

exercises: Fill in the blank with -는 대로 and the verb 받다: 자료를 ____ 바로 전달해 드리겠습니다.
Choose the right word: 어제 보낸 메시지에 아직 (답장 / 자료) 없어요.
Your team leader writes: 수정한 파일 보냈어요. Choose the more natural reply: ① 네, 확인 부탁드립니다. ② 네, 확인하는 대로 말씀드리겠습니다.
Answer in Korean, using the dialogue: 김 팀장은 왜 답장이 늦을 수 있어요?
Write in Korean, using -는 대로: Tell your coworker you will share the schedule as soon as the meeting ends.
answers: 외근 중이라서 답장이 늦을 수 있어요. (지금 외근 중이라서요.)
회의가 끝나는 대로 일정을 공유하겠습니다. (회의가 끝나는 대로 일정을 공유할게요.)
